title: 提交文案 · 制作人视角优化版（介绍 1678 字符）
scenario_summary: 一句话简介和项目介绍，分别复制到提交页对应栏
body:
**一句话简介：**

天塌了，洪水将至。你是女娲，五块石头，一次补天。The sky has fallen. Five stones, one flood, one chance to mend it.

**项目介绍：**

天塌了。你有五块石头，和一座正在被洪水吞没的山谷。

《补天》让你亲手做一件神话里的事：成为女娲。第一人称走进一个由 World Labs Marble 生成的灰色山谷：天上横着发光的裂缝，山在崩，泥色的洪水每一秒都在上涨。

核心循环只有一句话：找石、托石、投炉。难的是顺序。五块石头必须按五行相生投进鼎炉：木生火、火生土、土生金、金生水、水生木。第一块由你选，之后每一步都要想清楚；错一块，石碎，洪水猛涨。每局出生点和石头位置都会打乱，路线永远不同，结局记录你最快的一次补天。

五石熔成翻滚的五色石浆，你托着它飞上天裂，看它从中间向两头铺满裂缝。然后神话接着发生：立四极、斩黑龙、积芦灰。白光过后，同一片山谷回来了，青山绿水，飞鸟盘旋。女娲化作光点身归天地。你补好的这片山河，就是她留给人间的礼物。

工具即玩法：两个 Marble 世界是“破碎”与“补好”的两端；五色石、鼎炉、女娲、手臂来自 Tripo；洪水流动、裂缝明灭、闪电、熔合都直接在 Marble 的 splat 上实时计算。打开浏览器就能玩。

黑客松 Demo，持续迭代中。五行顺序与女娲结局为艺术处理。

The sky has fallen. You have five stones, and a valley the flood is swallowing.

Mending the Sky lets you do the thing the myth only describes: be Nüwa. In first person you walk a grey World Labs Marble valley under a glowing rift, mountains breaking, a muddy flood rising every second.

The loop is simple: find, carry, forge. The tension is the order. The stones must enter the furnace in the Five Phases generating cycle: wood, fire, earth, metal, water. Your first pick is free; every pick after is a decision, and a wrong one shatters the stone and surges the flood. Start and stone locations reshuffle every run, and your fastest mend is recorded.

The stones melt into churning five-coloured slurry; you carry it into the rift and watch it seal the sky. Then the myth plays out: pillars, dragon, reed ash. Through a whiteout the same valley returns, green, with birds overhead, and Nüwa dissolves into light. The world you mended is her gift to everyone after the flood.

Two Marble worlds are the broken and mended ends; Tripo made the stones, furnace, Nüwa and arm; flood, rift, lightning and mending run live on the splats. Plays in any browser. Hackathon demo, still evolving.
